part.text: The formatter currently converts a negative value directly to an unsigned value before grouping, losing the sign and producing its two’s-complement representation. I’ll reuse the library’s existing signed-integer conversion helper so it supplies both the absolute magnitude and `-` prefix, including the minimum signed value safely.
